actions: Inspect and desilt the 79 culverts on these channels before each rainy season and after big storms; check any that back water up for undersizing. | 163 mapped dump/waste points lie within 100 m of the channels: add skips and collection, enforce no-dumping, and fit trash screens upstream of culverts. | 1,039 buildings stand within 15 m of the channels: enforce the drainage reserve, starting with structures that narrow or cover the channel. | 2,624 buildings sit on low ground (< 2 m above the drain) within 150 m: SMS early warning on heavy-rain forecasts, raised floors and flood-proofing. | Only under 1% of the land within 500 m is still wetland: protect what remains as flood storage and stop further filling of the valley floor.
